text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: multiple pods in gpu-pool-7 entering CrashLoopBackOff (SIGSEGV) in runtime process (fused_attention_v2) on node gpu-3. Affected service: inference-runtime-v2. Severity: P1. Thread start 1789012345.

pagerduty: paging Aisha (oncall-sre) and Luca (runtime-eng). escalation policy: 2min.

Aisha (oncall-sre): On it. jumping in. first check: are we losing nodes or just pods? :eyes:

Jordan (infra): Node gpu-3 has recent kernel OOM_kill messages + repeated nvlink resets in dmesg. Not evicting pods yet, kubelet shows CrashLoopBackOff. No node reboot scheduled.

Luca (runtime-eng): I see consistent SIGSEGV at fused_attention_v2.cu:0x1a3f during startup. Stack frame points to mixed-precision path when loading KV cache for batch sizes > 8. Logs:```
[2026-03-01T02:05:12Z] runtime: fused_attention_v2.cpp:487 initialize_kernel() segfault (SIGSEGV)
Backtrace (most recent call first):
  fused_attention_v2+0x1a3f
  runtime_init+0x9b
  main+0x1f4
```
No signs of OOM inside container.

Priya (ml-eng): This kernel was recently enabled as part of the long-context perf rollout (quant-8 + fp16 fallback). We pushed a micro-optim that touches padding handling for variable seq lengths. Could be boundary case.

Aisha (oncall-sre): OK triage plan: 1) cordon node gpu-3 to stop scheduling new pods, 2) scale inference-runtime-v2 away from gpu-3, 3) rollback kernel toggle via configmap to force kernel_disabled for fused_attention_v2, 4) collect coredumps and gdb backtrace if we can attach.

Jordan (infra): Cordon done: `kubectl cordon gpu-3` — node marked. Eviction in progress.

Marta (support-lead): Notifying impacted customers: a small subset of low-latency dedicated tenants in eu-west-1 are served from gpu-pool-7. Preparing template message, ETA for mitigation?

Aisha (oncall-sre): Rolling restart of inference-runtime-v2 pods excluding gpu-3. Command:```bash
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-runtime-v2 -n prod --field-selector=spec.nodeName!=gpu-3
```
Applying now.

Luca (runtime-eng): While pods restart, I'll prepare a safe rollback to disable fused_attention_v2 via configmap `runtime-kernels` → set `fused_attention_v2: disabled`. Patch command:```bash
kubectl patch configmap runtime-kernels -n prod -p '{"data":{"fused_attention_v2":"disabled"}}'
```
This should force runtime to avoid the problematic kernel and fall back to reference attention. Expect throughput drop ~8-12% on long-context requests.

Priya (ml-eng): Also pushing a debug build with extra bounds checks to a canary image `runtime:v2.1-debug` for postmortem if needed. Will attach to a drained node for repro.

Aisha (oncall-sre): Support update: Marta, send customers a note: short degraded throughput, requests still served via fallback kernel, no data loss. ETA 15-20m.

Marta (support-lead): Sending now. Template: "We're mitigating an infrastructure issue in eu-west-1 affecting long-context requests; falling back to a safe kernel. You may see slightly higher latencies. We'll update in 20 minutes." :email:

Jordan (infra): Evictions finished, new pods scheduled on healthy nodes. Rolling restart completed at 1789012410.

Luca (runtime-eng): Configmap patched to disable fused_attention_v2 at 1789012415. Pods reloaded config and started. Monitoring logs now.

incidents-bot: Auto-check: error-rate on inference-runtime-v2 decreased from 12% -> 0.8% after rollback. Latency 95th increased +9%. No new crashloops detected.

Evan (customer-ops): Received a support ticket from a major customer reporting timeouts around 02:05 UTC, they were routed to degraded nodes. Do we have a post-incident customer impact summary scope?

Aisha (oncall-sre): Collecting metrics and spans for 02:00-02:20 UTC. Will compile impact matrix: requests failed, customer ids affected, latency deltas, and mitigation timeline.

Priya (ml-eng): Captured coredump from the earliest crashed container and uploaded to `s3://redwood-incidents/1789012345/dumps/fused_attn_core_1.gz`. Debug image attached for later reproduce.

Luca (runtime-eng): Quick root cause hypothesis: bounds-check regression in the new padding handling path for mixed-precision + batched KV cache. Reproducer steps noted in the debug branch. Will open a PR to revert micro-optim and add unit tests for variable-length batching.

Aisha (oncall-sre): Current status: node cordoned, kernel disabled, service stable with fallback, customer notifications sent, oncall -> handoff to next shift in 30m. Action items: runtime-eng to PR revert, ml-eng to run long-context perf regression tests, infra to monitor node gpu-3 hardware health.

Luca (runtime-eng): Working on PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789 (revert fused_attention_v2 patch + add tests). Target merge + canary deploy in 6 hours.

Jordan (infra): Scheduling hardware diagnostics for gpu-3; nvlink resets later today probably unrelated but we'll be sure.

Marta (support-lead): Final customer update draft: "Issue mitigated; we used a safe fallback kernel. We'll share RCA and timeline within 48 hours."

incidents-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Logging incident record 1789012345.

Aisha (oncall-sre): Wrapping up handoff notes for next oncall. Will add timeline + artifacts (coredump link, PR, configmap diff, metrics graphs) to the postmortem doc.

Luca (runtime-eng): 👍 will include repro steps and perf delta in the postmortem.

Priya (ml-eng): I'll run the expanded regression suite against the canary later and validate no further edge cases.

Evan (customer-ops): Thanks team. Keep me in the loop for the 48h RCA.

-- end thread --
